name: Ode To The Heroes
source:
In a world full of magic, demons, and monsters, You play as a fox morph with snow white fur.

A single mistake led him on a journey of becoming a Hero, but with unexpected trials along with the secrets he keep, will he become one? Is It worth It?

[From [url=https://0story-teller.itch.io/ode-to-the-heroes]Itch.io[/url]]
